realm_description: The coastline where continents first meet the wider world. Every citizen's story starts here, pulled outward by trade, curiosity, and the promise of connection.

primary.label: Storyteller
primary.description: Keeps identity, memory, and meaning alive across generations; around their fire, people remember who they are.
primary.guiding_promise: I will keep telling the story, so no one forgets who we are.
trait_descriptions: Keep the soul alive in words.
primary.shadow_description: Polishes the story so bright that the truth underneath quietly disappears.

secondary.label: Ranger
secondary.description: Moves between civilization and the wild with equal ease; nature trusts them for it.
secondary.guiding_promise: I will walk lightly, so what I protect still has somewhere to stand.
secondary.shadow_description: Stays so carefully balanced between two worlds that they never fully belong to either.

wheel.central_question: Should we preserve what happened, or keep alive the story of who we are?

growth.label: Ranger
growth.description: Moves between civilization and the wild with equal ease; nature trusts them for it.
growth.guiding_promise: I will walk lightly, so what I protect still has somewhere to stand.
growth.shadow_description: Stays so carefully balanced between two worlds that they never fully belong to either.

other_ally.label: Survivor
other_ally.description: Endures; resilience is the value they hold above all others.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I will rise from the ash, proving that our light cannot be crushed.
other_ally.shadow_description: Treats every calm moment as the quiet before the next disaster, and lets no one close enough to prove otherwise.

quarter.label: Oracle
quarter.description: Notices what hasn't happened yet — through a mind that sees connections others miss.
quarter.guiding_promise: I will speak the pattern I see, even when no one wants to hear it yet.
quarter.shadow_description: Mistakes a hunch for a prophecy, and loses the trust of anyone who asks for proof.

opposite.label: Historian
opposite.description: Gathers what happened — triumphs and shameful parts alike — so no one can pretend it didn't.
opposite.guiding_promise: I will remember honestly, even when forgetting would be easier.
opposite.shadow_description: Cannot let the past go, and lets old grievance calcify into bitterness dressed as memory.

realmmate.label: Diplomat
realmmate.description: Builds consensus, dreads open conflict more than slow progress.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I build bridges where others build walls.
realmmate.shadow_description: Smooths over a rupture that needed to be named, and calls the silence peace.

wheel.compatible_text: Diplomat · Messenger — fellow travelers of The Shoreline.
